versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Facebook Analytics skill.
- Track Facebook Page performance: reach, engagement, video views, and post metrics.
- Secure connection using an MCP Connector link (no local API keys required).
- Includes tools for real-time and historical analytics and publishing history.
- Easy setup—connect your Facebook Page via Boring, copy the MCP link, and start analyzing.
- Comprehensive documentation and troubleshooting guidance included.
